page_title: ACM 1-0 LEC | AC Milan v Lecce 18/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 91+3' Youssef Maleh (Lecce) goes for goal, but slices it wide of the target.
90+5' That's it for today, Luca Zufferli has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) cracked a first-time shot, but the goalkeeper pulled off an amazing save.
90+1' Lecce failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
87' Massimiliano Allegri is forced to make a change. Ardon Jashari (AC Milan) is unable to continue due to injury, Luka Modric comes on.
87' It's time for a substitution. Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) comes on in place of Rafael Leao.
85' Ylber Ramadani comes off the pitch to be replaced by Youssef Maleh (Lecce).
84' Eusebio Di Francesco prepares a substitution. Antonino Gallo is replaced by Konan Ndri (Lecce).
84' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
82' The attendance for today's match is 70591.
80' Alexis Saelemaekers is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Zachary Athekame (AC Milan).
79' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

76' 1 - 0 Alexis Saelemaekers produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Niclas Fullkrug (AC Milan) rises high to head the ball into the bottom left corner and beyond the goalkeeper. He makes it 1:0.
73' AC Milan have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
73' Substitution. Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) replaces Samuele Ricci.
72' It will be a substitution. Niclas Fullkrug (AC Milan) is ready to enter the pitch as Christian Pulisic walks off.
68' Here is a change. Nikola Stulic is going off and Eusebio Di Francesco gives the last tactical orders to Tete Morente (Lecce).
65' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) takes a first-time shot from inside the box, but his poor effort flies way wide of the right post.
64' The corner is swung in but AC Milan can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
63' Koni De Winter (AC Milan) commits a foul during an attacking move.
63' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for AC Milan.

62' It's unbelievable, Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) blows a huge opportunity! He is totally unmarked and fires a first-time shot to the bottom right corner from a few yards out, but Wladimiro Falcone reacts superbly to keep the ball out. The ball is out of play and AC Milan manage to earn a corner.
61' Lameck Banda (Lecce) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
58' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) times his run into the box beautifully and plants a good looking header at goal from the corner, but the ball flashes just over the bar.
57' The referee blows his whistle, AC Milan are awarded a corner kick.
57' The goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny Samuele Ricci (AC Milan), whose good effort would probably have ended inside the bottom right corner of the net.
56' Pervis Estupinan (AC Milan) pounced on a rebound on the edge of the box and his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar.
56' Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

55' The ball falls for Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) in the box, and he hits a first-time shot at goal that is inadvertently blocked by a defender. A bit unlucky there! The ball is out of play. AC Milan win a corner kick.
54' The substitution has been made. Lameck Banda (Lecce) has replaced Riccardo Sottil.
53' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) jumps highest to meet an accurate cross and heads the ball towards the net. His fine header whistles just inches over the crossbar.
53' AC Milan work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
53' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. The ball is out of play. AC Milan will have a chance to score from a corner.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
43' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) is flagged for offside.
43' A dangerous looking corner kick from Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) is cleared to safety by the defence.
42' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for AC Milan. The referee signals a corner kick to AC Milan.
40' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
38' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Nikola Stulic (Lecce) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
35' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) is adjudged offside.
35' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) fires the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by one of his teammates.
35' The resulting set piece from AC Milan is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

34' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range low towards the middle of the net, but Wladimiro Falcone was alert and made an amazing save! AC Milan get a corner.
34' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
31' The linesman raises his flag. Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) is adjudged offside.
30' Nikola Stulic (Lecce) leans back and sends a volley soaring over the bar from inside the box.
29' 0:0 – this is the current number of shots on target.
26' Jamil Siebert (Lecce) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
21' Koni De Winter (AC Milan) protests to the referee and receives a yellow card.
18' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
16' A corner kick by AC Milan is thwarted by the well prepared Wladimiro Falcone (Lecce).
13' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
9' A goal, which was scored by Rafael Leao (AC Milan), was disallowed due to offside.
7' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) blows a chance to score! He pinged a fine header from deep inside the box towards the net, but his aim was off and it flew narrowly wide of the left post.
6' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from the edge of the box, but it goes just wide of the left post.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Lecce will have the kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Luca Zufferli is the one to supervise the game today.
